in_marathi.name: Padmanabh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Lotus Navel
in_marathi.long_meaning: Padmanabh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Padmanabh is derived from two Sanskrit words - Padma (lotus) and Anabh (navel). This name is used to describe Lord Vishnu, who is believed to have the universe within his navel in Hindu mythology.
